objective:
The next engineering iteration should make unknowns and conflicts explicit, tighten name matching, retain signature-coverage facts, and validate vendor claims through documented methods. Then we need labelled experiments measuring errors and unresolved cases.

Continue we need better visibility, truthfulness and correctness. Read authoritative code and open source libraries, how are others doing it? Lets borrow ideas, to improve our approaches further. Iterate, lookup, experiment and improve our analytics.

previousGoalTurn.scope: Second consecutive check revalidated the same source/input gates without edits or deployment.

scope: Third consecutive no-progress dependency check; thirteen source hashes remain unchanged. No new account/production measurement, human label or authorization. Full objective remains incomplete.

history.preservation: All prior keys and bytes are preserved exactly. Current interpretation is here; per-experiment details remain in their owning receipts.

requirements.limit: Missing, unsupported, conflicting and native unavailable values stay distinct. This does not prove human accuracy or managed-verifier agreement.
Exact lexical product boundaries and multiple candidates are retained. Nine catalogue source hashes still match; source configuration is neither fresh vendor validation nor an authenticated operator.

Selected verified-proof coverage is preserved with profile provenance. Unsigned UA/path and discarded original evidence cannot be reconstructed by current code. Current verifier repairs do not rewrite old rows or prove production race frequency.

requirements.requirement: Validate vendor claims through documented methods, authoritative code and independent verification
requirements.limit: Recorded-time fixtures and selected captures have native-local and independent RFC evidence. No accepted request-level managed signedAgent oracle or eligible controlled identity exists. The response-advisory no-adoption decision is closed under current evidence; known decimal-parameter grammar limits remain explicit.

requirements.requirement: Run labelled experiments measuring errors and unresolved cases
requirements.limit: The separate October30 production cohort has twelve known automation controls, three correct decisions and nine abstentions. It has zero human labels. This corrects the older claim that no fresh production automation cohort exists; it does not establish accuracy for the current deployment or the population.

requirements.requirement: Explain measurement divergence and rule changes before making growth claims
requirements.limit: Weekly joint measurement history is implemented and has dated production acceptance; Research108's identical-report counterexample is superseded for that gap. Stage controls distinguish response/script/queue/receipt, but representative human/device/RUM behavior remains unmeasured.

requirements.limit: Historical source sensitivity and article rankings are delivery evidence. They do not prove human growth, authentic referrals, search queries, useful reading or retention. No new census or authenticated query report is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Respect EU and US guidance while preserving useful evidence
requirements.limit: Expanded raw diagnostics remain unactivated under the unresolved boundary. Source/default policy, dated off-mode acceptance and provider terms are not a completed applicability, lawful-basis, aggregate-preserving retention, rights/contact or transfer review.

requirements.limit: Source hash matches the accepted 1379-word/32-prompt version. No fresh served-content check or new reader outcome is claimed.

resumedAudit.thisTurnClassification: no progress: same required external/user input condition for three consecutive goal turns
resumedAudit.historicalBlockedAudit: Prior blocked history is preserved in the archive; this is a separate resumed-run blocked audit.

nextBoundedAction: Resume from an actual newly available native/search/human/privacy/source-purpose input that can change a named decision. Preserve accepted runtime no-adoption and release checks. Do not repeat accepted controls, scan history or expand optional protocol work solely to keep the goal running.

latestDependencyCheck.status: The same required native/search/human/privacy/source-purpose inputs remain unavailable. No new dedicated input tool or user-supplied authorization/measurement exists. No gated origin/account access, local-control repetition or policy expansion attempted.

blockedAudit.condition: Substantive remaining requirements need unavailable user/external inputs; another local protocol or bookkeeping iteration cannot establish native agreement, human accuracy, search demand, historical completeness, purpose or privacy acceptance.
blockedAudit.resume: A new decision-changing native/search/human/privacy/source-purpose input, under the existing acceptance requirements. Do not infer approval from another automatic continuation.
